name: Melvin Alexander
bio: Melvin Alexander is a retired Statistical Engineering Analytician from Greensboro, NC. He holds a master’s degree in Biostatistics from the University of North Carolina-Chapel Hill. He is an ASQ Fellow, a past Chair of ASQ’s Baltimore Section and Healthcare Division, current member of ASQ’s Peer Review Committee for ASQ Quality Press, ASQ’s Shainin Award Committee, and Certified Quality Engineer.

history.title: Applying Predictive Modeling and Computer Vision (CV) Tools Useful in Biomedicine and Public Health
